name: Tapo Control
author: Aperture
description: Pan/tilt control for TP-Link Tapo cameras, spoken directly to the camera over ONVIF on your own network. Adds a jog wheel over the picture and a device menu to the player toolbar. No cloud account and no vendor bridge.

settings.label: Camera account username
settings.help: The Tapo CAMERA ACCOUNT, not your TP-Link cloud login. Create it in the Tapo app under the camera's Advanced Settings → Camera Account. It is the same account the RTSP stream uses.

settings.label: Camera account password
settings.help: Stored server-side and never returned to the browser. It is sent only to the camera addresses listed below.

settings.label: Camera mapping
settings.help: Which Tapo camera each Aperture camera is. The address is the camera's ONVIF endpoint — Tapo serves it on port 2020, so http://<camera-ip>:2020. Only the addresses listed here may ever be contacted.

settings.label: Jog step (ms)
settings.help: How long one nudge of the jog wheel moves the camera. ONVIF pans continuously until told to stop, so this is the unit of movement.

settings.label: Jog speed (%)
settings.help: How fast a nudge moves, as a percentage of the camera's maximum pan/tilt velocity.
